pageTitle: How it works | The Hands-Off Hiring System | Handoff
pageDescription: A four-step process that keeps the sourcing and screening with us. You make one decision at the end: which finalist to place.
body: A four-step process that keeps the sourcing and screening with us. You make one decision at the end: which finalist to place.

steps.title: Discovery
steps.body: We learn about your team, where and why they need support, and what a strong candidate fit looks like. Your ideal talent profile then sets the bar for our search.

steps.title: The Vet
steps.body: We start with roughly 200 candidates and screen down.
bullets: A skills assessment for the role
steps.after: Only the candidates who clear the full screen move forward.

steps.title: Your Shortlist
steps.body: You see two. We present two candidates matched to your ideal talent profile, with their video submissions, assessment results and our notes. You host the interviews and choose the best fit.

steps.title: The Guarantee
steps.body: If your hire doesn't work out within 90 days, we replace them at no cost. We run the screening, so a miss is on us to fix.

closer.line: Every hire after your first gets easier. We learn your company, your culture, your bar for 'great.' By hire five, many clients trust us enough to skip straight to day one.

pageCloser.headline: Start with the role
pageCloser.line: Tell us what you need to fill, and we'll open the search.
